title: README try-it prompts: direct vs OSS v1 vs OSS v2 vs the Context Mode gateway (Opus 5.5)
harness: start-cost-ab-arms --workloads tryit (gateway repo worktree, local branch, never pushed) + bench/gateway-ab/tryit.patch

arms.plain: Claude Code alone (direct). Empty strict MCP map, no plugin.
arms.v1: OSS plugin v1: origin/main a92cf6a77ac02971fb5fafe2155e5ee229491884, version 1.0.169, npm install --omit=dev.
arms.v2: OSS plugin v2: v2-design 7f320e1664577c5389f37d0fbd250f867ed69fcc built to release-out (manifest version 0.0.0-dev).
arms.gateway: Claude Code talks to Anthropic through the live Context Mode gateway, default tenant flags. First run: one new disposable tenant per prompt. Amendment 1: one new disposable tenant per session.

cost_basis: Client arms: list price on the token counts in each session's result event; cache writes whose lifetime is not split are priced at the 1 hour rate. Gateway arm: list price on the gateway's per-call record for the session, hidden calls included; analyze.mjs prices the record again and stops on a difference. Claude Code's own total_cost_usd is kept as usd_client. The runs used a claude.ai login: every figure is a list-price equivalent, not an invoice.
bytes_basis: Sum over every tool_result block in the session transcript (stream-json user events): UTF-8 bytes of each text part; a non-text part counts as the bytes of its JSON. Tool calls: tool_use blocks in assistant events. compact_boundary: system events of that subtype. Gateway arm: the bytes the client sent; the gateway can change them before the model sees them, and the record does not hold that size.
analysis_method: Every measured cycle, failures included, no outlier dropped. Per prompt, d = arm - plain per cycle. % = 100 x mean(d) / mean(plain), with the 95% t interval at df = n - 1 (t = 3.182 at n = 4). Verdict: less when the whole interval is below zero, more when above, else same. arm_wins: cycles where the arm cost less than plain. v2 against v1 is secondary. session-continuity: demonstration only.

success_rules.large-json: the planted record value is in the final answer, read against the served data on disk; fails closed (no-served-data-on-disk) when no served file exists
success_rules.git-history: the final answer names the top git shortlog author over the same 500 commits
success_rules.large-json (amendment 1): every scalar leaf of the record at index 13000, JSON-parsed from the last tool_result that served or generated it, appears whole in the final answer; fails closed (no-record-in-tool-result) when no such tool_result exists
success_rules.other: completion check: end_turn, at least one tool call, non-empty answer. First run: client tool calls only. Amendment 1: client tool calls plus gateway edge_calls. Not a quality check.

pooled.note: Sum over the measured pairs of the five counted prompts (amendment-1 pairs for web-scrape, docs-search and large-json; first-run pairs for the other two). Descriptive only: no interval, the rows are different prompts.

readme_claims.rule: HOLDS when the measured median is within 25% of the claimed number, else DIFFERS. A link the run did not exercise is INCONCLUSIVE.
